name: Xbox 360 Wireless Controller
notes: Wireless receiver, not the controller itself. The receiver is the USB device; individual wireless controllers do not have USB PIDs. Real protocol uses vendor-specific USB class (0xFF/0x5D/0x01); the receiver-side driver synthesizes a standard Xbox 360 HID descriptor on its bus child for each paired controller, so nativeDescriptor reflects the xinputhid-synthesized form (X+Y, Rx+Ry, combined Z) and matches xbox-360-wired byte-for-byte. The shipped descriptor adds an HM-specific Vx (0x40) + Vy (0x41) Physical Collection so the BuildReportInto combined-Z synthesis can populate joy.cpl Z from (rt - lt) while routing separate LT / RT to Vx / Vy for WGI / XInput. PID 0x0291 is the v2 receiver. Routes through hidmaestro_xusb.inf XUSB companion (matches xbox-360-wired path); no xinputhid driver mode (would force 16-button gamepad layout, breaking subtype fidelity).
